verdict.rationale: The CDP SDK lets developers programmatically create and use wallets while CDP secures the private keys (gh-2, gh-1). The Agentic Wallet gives an agent its own standalone wallet, with configurable per-session and per-transaction spending caps (docs-25, docs-45) and a per-payment --max-amount limit (docs-42). Further controls include write-action approval in Base MCP (docs-57) and spend permissions for USDC subscriptions (docs-34). Missing for 10: explicitly scoped or least-privilege agent keys, a broader policy engine beyond spend caps (e.g. allowlists, asset or network restrictions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
